# BTree V2 interoperability fixtures

`btree_v2_java_none.bin` and `btree_v2_java_lz4.bin` are generated by the Java
production `BTreeIndexWriter`, using `GenerateBTreeV2.java` in its package to
select file version 2. They were generated against apache/paimon `b5bcf9babce`.

Integer keys 0–5 exercise a singleton, a sparse delta list, dense Roaring runs,
a run crossing the high-32-bit boundary, `Long.MAX_VALUE`, and a compressible
delta list. Two null rows exercise the unchanged null-bitmap format. Blocks
have a target size of 64 bytes. The LZ4 fixture contains both compressed and
uncompressed blocks: the Java SST writer compresses only when it saves space.

To regenerate, compile the helper with the Java `paimon-common` / `paimon-api`
classes and their runtime dependencies on the classpath, then run:

```sh
javac -cp "$PAIMON_CLASSPATH" -d "$CLASSES_DIR" GenerateBTreeV2.java
java -cp "$CLASSES_DIR:$PAIMON_CLASSPATH" \
  org.apache.paimon.globalindex.btree.GenerateBTreeV2 .
```

Rust tests read the Java files and compare the Rust V2 writer's uncompressed
output byte-for-byte with the Java fixture. A writer/reader round-trip alone
would not catch incompatible posting tags, portable bitmap layout, or footer
versions.
